nodes.name: AI: Pre-Flight QA, Policy Check & VIP Margin Audit (JSON)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', temperature: 0.0, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are a CRM & Marketing Automation Pre-Flight QA auditor. Audit the email draft against technical QA rules AND the store policy truth table. Check: (1) Klaviyo Liquid / HubSpot HubL merge tags with missing or empty fallbacks, (2) commercial links missing UTMs or breaking lowercase GA4 naming, (3) mobile subject >50 chars or redundant preheader, (4) missing unsubscribe tag, (5) unsupported claims vs store facts (e.g., shipping SLA not published, rolling expiry promised on static code), (6) promotional discount detected without required VIP/Recent-Buyer/CX-Hold exclusions on the target segment. Return strictly JSON: status (PASS | FAIL), has_discount_offer (bool), blockers (array of {category, issue, fix}), warnings (array of {category, issue, fix}).' }, { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify({ draft: $('Form / Webhook: Submit Campaign Draft').item.json.body, policy: $json }) } ] }) }}

nodes.notes: Temperature 0.0 for deterministic rule checking + JSON output. Supports OpenAI or Google Gemini 2.5 Flash.

nodes.name: Parse AI QA Audit Result (Safe Defaults)

assignments.name: status
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { try { const raw = ($json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || $json.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text || '{}').replace(/```json|```/g, '').trim(); return JSON.parse(raw).status || 'FAIL'; } catch { return 'FAIL'; } })() }}

assignments.name: has_discount_offer
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { try { const raw = ($json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || $json.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text || '{}').replace(/```json|```/g, '').trim(); return Boolean(JSON.parse(raw).has_discount_offer); } catch { return false; } })() }}

assignments.name: blockers
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { try { const raw = ($json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || $json.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text || '{}').replace(/```json|```/g, '').trim(); const b = JSON.parse(raw).blockers; return Array.isArray(b) ? b : []; } catch { return [{ category: 'qa_engine_error', issue: 'AI QA output could not be parsed cleanly', fix: 'Re-run Pre-Flight QA or check API credentials before scheduling.' }]; } })() }}

assignments.name: warnings
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { try { const raw = ($json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || $json.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text || '{}').replace(/```json|```/g, '').trim(); const w = JSON.parse(raw).warnings; return Array.isArray(w) ? w : []; } catch { return []; } })() }}

nodes.notes: Parses JSON once so downstream Slack messages print every blocker and fix cleanly without repeated JSON.parse calls.
